title: When AI Benchmarks Plateau: A Systematic Study of Benchmark Saturation
authors: Mubashara Akhtar, Anka Reuel, Prajna Soni, et al. (37 authors, incl. Stella Biderman, Irene Solaiman)
used_for: 61 developer reports / 190 benchmarks; 60 in sustained use; 29/60 highly saturated; age and test size predict saturation; private test sets do not help; no game benchmarks among the 60
verify_note: Fact-check: PMLR v306 post and PDF re-read independently (title, 37 authors, pp. 1602-1629, 43rd ICML, date 2026-09-29); arXiv:2602.16763 seen in agents-radar HN digests (Aug 2026). CAUTION on framing: the 60 benchmarks are NOT all 'sustained-use' benchmarks. Candidates came from (1) 61 developer reports (190 benchmarks; >=5-report filter applies only to these), (2) highly cited benchmark papers via Semantic Scholar, and (3) hypothesis-driven additions from Google Scholar searches (Section 3.1). Expert-curation effect is an age-confounded comparison (H3) that the authors describe as suggestive.
